name: Farmer's Defence 2
detailed_description:
Welcome to Farmer's Defence 2

Farmer’s Defence 2 is a farming survival game where you grow crops, battle relentless weeds, and upgrade tools to protect your farm. How long can you last before the weeds take over?

Key Features:

  • 10 Unique Crops: Manage plants with varying growth speeds, rot times, and values to maximize profits.

  • Escalating Weed Threat: Weeds spread faster, grow thicker, and become tougher to remove as time progresses.

  • Tiered Tools: Unlock three tiers of upgrades to work faster and fight weeds more effectively.

Details:

Plant, water, and harvest crops while racing against weeds that spread aggressively, destroying your hard work. Time your harvests perfectly to sell crops at peak freshness for the best prices—wait too long, and they’ll rot. As the game progresses, weeds grow thicker and spread faster, demanding constant attention and quick action to pull them manually.

Survive by upgrading tools across three tiers: basic starting gear evolves into high-efficiency equipment to plow, water, and remove weeds faster. Multiple difficulty levels and improved graphics add depth and replayability. Can you outlast the weeds and earn enough to call your farm a success?
